prompt: What kind of photo does the team lead want for the north panel?
promptZh: 組長想要哪種北側壁面照片？

options.text: A photo of the empty tray with a position label
options.zh: 有定位標籤的空托盤照
options.whyZh: 托盤用於已取下磁磚的定位，不是北側比色照片。

options.text: A photo showing the new and original tiles side by side
options.zh: 新磚與原磚並排的照片
options.whyZh: 組長要求把新磁磚放在原有磁磚旁拍照，供設計師比色。

options.text: A photo of W9 after it has been lifted
options.whyZh: W9 屬西側，而且應先拍原位照。

options.text: A photo showing only the green mark
options.whyZh: 綠色標記不是顏色比對；照片應同時展示新舊磚。

explanationZh: 組長要求把新磁磚放在原有磁磚旁拍照，供設計師比色。
evidence:
Document 3 · Message from team lead
Our clean trays will arrive before lunch. Start documenting W9 now; wait for a clean tray before lifting it. The new tile for the north panel looks close in colour, but send a photo beside an original tile to the designer and wait for confirmation before using it. There is no need to redo the north panel’s moisture check.

vocabulary.note: beside 表示在旁邊；放在一起拍可記錄兩件物品在相同光線下的外觀。
